results.title: Companies for you
results.explainer: Verified means our team checked the company's licence on the official portal. Unverified means we haven't checked yet. Neither says anything about service quality.
results.reviews: ({count, plural, =1 {1 verified review} other {# verified reviews}})
results.stale: Price not updated for over 60 days. Ask the company to confirm.
results.renewalWarning: Renewal cost not stated. Ask before you commit.
results.pricesNote: Prices are supplied by each company and confirmed in their written quote. Government fees are indicative.
results.empty: No companies match these answers yet. Try another location or fewer services.

profile.verifiedBody: Licence checked on the official portal: {date}. The badge expires with the licence and is re-checked after that.
profile.verifiedNote: Verified confirms the licence only. It is not a guarantee of service quality.
profile.unverifiedBody: We haven't checked this company's licence yet. You can still request a quote, but check their licence yourself before paying anything.
profile.supplied: Supplied by the company, updated {date}. Confirmed in their written quote.
profile.reviewsNote: Reviews come only from customers who completed a service through the app.
profile.ctaNote: Free. Your details go only to this company, and only with your OK.
